statements.name: Sylvester's law of inertia
statements.correspondence: Document: A = L D L^H, L invertible, D real diagonal => #negative eigenvalues of A = #negative entries of D. Lean: sylvester_inertia gives cntLt hA 0 = #{d<0} and cntLe hA 0 = #{d<=0}; cntLt_eq_of_factor at a shift t and for rectangular L with a two-sided inverse of L^H; sylvester_card compares two factorizations without eigenvalues.

statements.name: eigenvalue count = largest dimension of a negative subspace
statements.source: used by every count of code/certify-ed/docs/theory.md §3
statements.correspondence: Not a numbered statement of the documents; the min-max fact in subspace form on which all counts rest. Mathlib v4.35.0 has no Courant-Fischer theorem for matrices.

statements.name: Weyl's inequality, counting and sorted form
statements.correspondence: Document: |lambda_j(A) - lambda_j(B)| <= rho for Hermitian A, B with ||A-B|| <= rho. Lean: counting form cntLt hA t <= cntLt hB (t+rho) and cntLe hA t <= cntLe hB (t+rho) under |x^H (A-B) x| <= rho ||x||^2 (weyl_cntLt, weyl_cntLe; weyl_opNorm under the operator-norm bound), and the sorted form |eigAsc hA j - eigAsc hB j| <= rho with eigAsc the ascending eigenvalues (weyl_sorted, weyl_sorted_opNorm).

statements.name: spectral-norm hypotheses imply quadratic-form hypotheses
statements.correspondence: ||M z|| <= rho ||z|| for all z in EuclideanSpace implies |x^H M x| <= rho ||x||^2 (Cauchy-Schwarz); Lemma 4, Weyl and Theorem 8 restated with the norm hypotheses of the documents.

statements.name: Lemma 4, inertia with backward error
statements.correspondence: Document: ||L D L^H - P(A - sigma I)P^T|| <= beta, L unit lower triangular, D block diagonal with nu negative eigenvalues => #{lambda < sigma-beta} <= nu <= #{lambda <= sigma+beta} (theory.md) or < (manuscript v4). Lean: lemma4 gives the strict (manuscript) form for any L whose conjugate transpose has a two-sided inverse and diagonal D, with E = L D L^H - (A - sigma I) bounded in quadratic form; lemma4_doc the theory.md form; lemma4_opNorm with the spectral norm; lemma4_hermitian for Hermitian (block) D with nu = its negative eigenvalue count; lemma4_perm with P any unitary matrix. Unit triangularity is not needed.

statements.name: count of a 2 x 2 pivot block
statements.source: code/certify-ed/docs/theory.md §3 (2 x 2 blocks by the sign of a rational determinant)
statements.correspondence: Hermitian 2x2 D: det<0 => exactly one negative eigenvalue; det>0 => two or none by the sign of the trace. With cnt_blockDiagonal' the count of block-diagonal D is the sum over blocks.

statements.name: Corollary 5, completeness and sorted pairing
statements.correspondence: (H1) as group map, radii constant on groups, disjoint group hulls [lo g, hi g], injection phi with |lambda(phi j) - mu j| <= r j (injective_of_groups builds it from group-wise injections); (H2) as cntLt hA (sigma-beta) <= k; (H3) mu j + r j < sigma - beta. Conclusions in counting form: exactly k eigenvalues below the cut and they are the matched ones (image_eq_of_match); #{mu l <= mu j} <= cntLe (mu j + r j) and cntLt (mu j - r j) <= #{mu l < mu j}; for sorted mu : Fin k -> R, j+1 <= cntLe (mu j + r j) and cntLt (mu j - r j) <= j, i.e. lambda_{j+1} in [mu_j - r_j, mu_j + r_j]; cor5_model: model shift Delta with the document's (H3), exactly k eigenvalues of A_m below sigma-beta-Delta and pairing within r_j + Delta. The gap bound is the difference of the two bounds and is not stated separately. Sorted form (Sorted.lean): cor5_eigAsc gives |eigAsc hA j - mu_j| <= r_j for j < k and eigAsc hA k >= c; cor5_model_eigAsc gives |eigAsc hAm j - mu_j| <= r_j + Delta and eigAsc hAm k >= sigma - beta - Delta for the declared model.

statements.name: a-posteriori backward error of the sparse factorization
statements.missing: part (c) and the sandwich with the computed beta for complex data (the rounded moduli fl(|z|) of the complex residual entries and the complex matrix-vector products of G1); the underflow hypothesis of the document is replaced by the standard model without underflow (eta = 0)
statements.correspondence: Standard model of CertifyMathlib.Enclosure.FloatModel (eta = 0), every sum along an arbitrary summation tree. Real data: d01_a is (a), |E_ij| <= |E_c,ij|/(1 - u) + gamma_{w+1} G_ij for w >= t_ij; d01_b is (b) as absolute row sums (with Lemma R1, abs_qf_le_rowSum, for the 2-norm). Complex data: d01_a_c and d01_b_c with gamma_{t+3} <= g_{t+1} = 2 gamma_{t+5}. d01_count, d01_count_c: the sandwich with beta = R + s from (b) (lemma4_perm_rowSum, P unitary). Part (c), real data: the code of sparse_ldl_residual_bound (certify_ed/ldl_residual.py lines 108 to 161) as residInfFl, roundInfFl, shiftFl, betaFl; lambda_r1, lambda_r2 are (Lambda-R1), (Lambda-R2) in the form the proof uses (m <= 2^27, n <= 2^26); d01_c: sum_j |E_ij| + 2u |S_ii| <= beta for all i; d01_count_fl: #{lambda(A) < sigma - beta} <= nu <= #{lambda(A) <= sigma + beta} with the stored S = A - sigma I + diag Delta, |Delta_i| <= 2u |S_ii|.

statements.name: spectrum of a block-diagonal matrix is the union of the block spectra
statements.correspondence: For B = blockDiagonal' H: cntLt hB t = sum_s cntLt (hH s) t and the same for cntLe, for every t, which is equality of eigenvalue multisets.

statements.name: Theorem 8, sector assembly
statements.correspondence: Steps 1-2 (thm8_blocks: uniform radius r, sector counts cntLt (H_s) (E_cut - beta_s) <= k_s give exactly K eigenvalues of B below E_cut - max beta and the pooled pairing) and Steps 3-5 (thm8: square Q with Q^H Q = Q Q^H = 1, |y^H (Q^H H Q - B) y| <= rho ||y||^2, |x^H (H - H_spec) x| <= m_b ||x||^2). Polar step: polarMat W is the matrix of the enclosure part's polar factor (Enclosure.polarQ via toEuclideanLin.symm); for square W with ||W^H W - I|| <= eta < 1 it is unitary (polarMat_conjTranspose_mul, polarMat_mul_conjTranspose) and ||H Q - Q B|| <= D + (||H|| + ||B||) delta with delta = 1 - sqrt(1 - eta) (polarMat_residual, from Enclosure.polarQ_residual_le), hence |y^H (Q^H H Q - B) y| <= rho ||y||^2 (polarMat_qf). thm8_polar: the conclusion with rho = D + (||H|| + ||B||) delta and epsilon = rho + m_b; thm8_sectors: W = [V_1 ... V_m] and D >= (sum_s ||H V_s - V_s H_s||_F^2)^(1/2) as compose.certify_low_energy computes it. Sorted form: with e : Fin K ~ (sum s, kappa s) listing the claimed values increasingly, |lambda_j(H_spec) - c_(j)| <= r + epsilon for j <= K and lambda_(K+1)(H_spec) >= E_cut - max beta - epsilon (thm8_sorted, thm8_opNorm_sorted, thm8_polar_sorted). With m_b = 0 this is thm:compose of the manuscript with rho as in thm8_rho.md.

statements.name: sorted-index forms of the j-th eigenvalue statements
statements.correspondence: eigAsc hA j := hA.eigenvalues0 (Fin.rev j) is the (j+1)-th smallest eigenvalue with multiplicity (Mathlib's eigenvalues0 is decreasing). eigAsc hA j <= t iff j + 1 <= cntLe hA t, and t <= eigAsc hA j iff cntLt hA t <= j; eigAsc_mem_of_counts turns the two halves of a pairing into an interval for eigAsc. sorted_of_thm8_counts derives the sorted form of Theorem 8 from its counting conclusions. Sorted forms are stated for Weyl, E-04, Corollary 5 (and its model transfer) and Theorem 8 (three variants).

statements.name: Theorem 6, projector bound
statements.correspondence: specProj hA T = U diag(1_T) U^H is the spectral projector of A on the eigen-indices T, = eigCols eigCols^H. sinTheta (Davis-Kahan sin Theta theorem, spectral norm, interval form): for Q^H Q = 1 and any Lambda with ||Lambda - c I|| <= w, if every eigenvalue of A outside T satisfies |lambda - c| >= w + sep, then ||(I - P) Q|| <= ||A Q - Q Lambda|| / sep. proj_sub_le: for equal ranks and s < 1, ||Q2 Q2^H - Q1 Q1^H|| <= s. thm6_proj: ||Qhat Qhat^H - P|| <= s = rho/sep with rho = ||R|| + (||A|| + ||Lambda||) delta and the separation measured from [c - w, c + w] (for Lambda = diag(mu), c and w the midpoint and half-width of [min mu, max mu]). thm6_ritz: the same with the separation measured from the hull of the Ritz values (eigenvalues of H' = Qhat^H A Qhat), the wording of thm:dk. thm6_X: ||X X^H - P|| <= s + eta. thm6_trace: |tr(X^H O X) - tr(P O)| <= (g + #T) ||X X^H - P|| ||O||, i.e. 2 g ||O|| (s + eta) when #T = g; Mathlib v4.35.0 has no trace norm, so the rank bound |tr(E O)| <= #{nonzero eigenvalues of E} ||E|| ||O|| (norm_trace_mul_le) replaces Hoelder.

statements.name: E-07 Lemma 1, Frobenius sin Theta
statements.correspondence: e07_lemma1_sharp: delta'^2 ||(I - P) Qhat||_F^2 <= ||(I - P)(A Qhat - Qhat Lambda)||_F^2 for any Hermitian Lambda whose eigenvalues are at distance >= delta' from every eigenvalue of A outside T (with Lambda = H' the first inequality of the document); e07_lemma1: <= ||A Qhat - Qhat Lambda||_F^2 (the second). Proof through the projector identity (I - P)(A Qhat - Qhat Lambda) = A Y - Y Lambda, Y = (I - P) Qhat, and frob_sylvester. Qhat need not be orthonormal in the Lean statement.

statements.name: E-07 Lemma 2, polar identities
statements.correspondence: (i) A Qhat - Qhat H' = (I - Qhat Qhat^H) R M^-1 and ||A Qhat - Qhat H'||_F^2 <= ||R||_F^2 / (1 - eta) (e07_lemma2_i, any Lambda). (ii) ||H' - Lambda|| <= ||X^H R|| / (1 - eta) + 2 delta w / sqrt(1 - eta) for ||Lambda - c I|| <= w (e07_lemma2_ii); with c the midpoint of [min mu, max mu], 2 w = spread(mu), which is the document's w'.

statements.name: E-07 Proposition 1, s_DK
statements.correspondence: e07_prop1: ||(I - P) Qhat|| <= ||R||_F / (sqrt(1 - eta) (dist - w')) when every other eigenvalue lies at distance >= dist from [c - w, c + w] (= [min mu, max mu]), ||Lambda - c I|| <= w and ||H' - Lambda|| <= w' < dist. e07_prop1_proj: ||Qhat Qhat^H - P|| <= s_DK for #T = g and s_DK < 1 (for s_DK >= 1 the bound holds because two orthogonal projectors differ by at most 1 in norm; that case is not stated).

statements.name: E-07 Lemma 3, alignment
statements.correspondence: For isometries Q1 (n x k) and Q2 (n x g) with k = g and ||(I - Q1 Q1^H) Q2|| <= s < 1, the polar factor U of Q1^H Q2 is unitary and ||Q2 - Q1 U|| <= s + s^2. With Q1 = Q, Q2 = Qhat this is the document's statement (s >= sin theta_max).

statements.name: E-07 Proposition 2 (C-12), approximate-symmetry labels
statements.missing: part (a) (an eigenvalue of S within (c + ||S|| w/2)/gamma_0 of each m_i, from the commutator bound) and the combined bound D
statements.correspondence: Part (b): for the sorted eigenvalues m_hat_j of X^H S X and m_j of the exact compression Q^H S Q (Q with Q^H Q = 1 spanning range P, ||(I - Q Q^H) Qhat|| <= s < 1, S Hermitian), |m_hat_j - m_j| <= (2 s + 2 s^2 + eta) ||S|| (c12_prop2_b), from Lemma 3, Weyl, the unitary invariance of sorted eigenvalues (eigAsc_conj) and Ostrowski's theorem for X^H S X = M (Qhat^H S Qhat) M (ostrowski_polar in counting form, ostrowski_sorted: |m_hat_j - k_j| <= eta |k_j|).

statements.name: E-07 Proposition 3 (C-13), overlap of two certified eigenspaces
statements.correspondence: For P_i = Q_i Q_i^H with Q_2^H Q_2 = 1 (rank k2), ||X_i X_i^H - P_i|| <= e_i and ||X_1^H X_1 - I|| <= eta_1: |tr(P_1 P_2) - tr(X_1 X_1^H X_2 X_2^H)| <= k2 e_1 + g (1 + eta_1) e_2 and Re tr(X_1 X_1^H X_2 X_2^H) = ||X_1^H X_2||_F^2. With e_i = s_i + eta_i (thm6_X) and k2 = g this is the document's bound.

statements.name: Proposition 14, degeneracy bracketing
statements.correspondence: (a), (b) as #I_in + nu_lo <= nu_hi and nu_hi <= nu_lo + #I_out with the hypothesis sigma_lo + beta_lo < sigma_hi - beta_hi (I_in non-empty, as in part (b) of the derivation document; theory.md §9.1 omits it and the inequality is false without it); (c) bracket_exact; (e) bracket_ge; (d) is (a). (H1) as g distinct eigen-indices with eigenvalues in I_in.

statements.missing: Sturm's theorem and Yun's squarefree factorization on Mathlib; hypothesis (H2) (exactness of python-flint) is outside Lean
statements.correspondence: Not attempted.

statements.name: Proposition 15, summed bounds
statements.correspondence: Inequality (1), exact, for any RCLike field (summed_bound). Corollary (2) and Lemmas A and B in the standard model of CertifyMathlib.Enclosure.FloatModel (eta = 0, u <= 2^-10): modulusUpper is modulus_upper of certify_ed/correlations.py with its three branches and modulusUpper_ge is Lemma A (no underflow hypothesis is needed in this model); dotFlC is numpy.sum(a * v) as complex products from four real products and two real sums summed along any tree with componentwise rounding, and dotFlC_error is Lemma B with gamma_{m+2}; add_up is modelled by any succ with z <= succ(fl(z)) (numpy.nextafter); p15_fl is (2) for the bound returned by combine_certified, m >= 1, and p15_fl_zero the case m = 0 (value 0, bound add_up(0, 0)).

statements.name: Proposition 16, thermodynamic intervals
statements.missing: dyadic interval arithmetic of Lemma 17 (outward-rounded exp and ln; enclosure part)
statements.correspondence: (H) as an assignment kappa of eigen-indices to intervals with fibre sizes c_k; enclosures of Z e^{beta E0}, sum e_i e^{-beta e_i}, sum e_i^2 e^{-beta e_i}; quotient enclosure; F = E0 - T ln Z-tilde. Z is the sum over Mathlib's eigenvalues. Var(e) = <e^2> - <e>^2 >= 0 by a weighted Cauchy-Schwarz inequality; variance interval [max(0, a2 - b1^2), b2 - a1^2] from enclosures of <e> >= 0 and <e^2>; C = beta^2 Var(E) in beta^2 times that interval. Shift identity of the proof: mean_shift (<e + c> = <e> + c) and variance_shift (Var(e + c) = Var(e)), so U = E_0 + <e> and Var(E) = Var(e).

statements.name: C-06 truncated thermodynamics (Proposition 16')
statements.missing: the outward-rounded evaluation of the interval ends by Lemma 17 (dyadic exp and ln) in (iii), and the statement that phi and psi tend to 0 at infinity (not needed by the Lean form of the case without M)
statements.correspondence: Lemma C: phi(e) = e e^{-beta e} increasing on [0, 1/beta], decreasing on [1/beta, inf), maximum e^{-1}/beta at 1/beta; psi(e) = e^2 e^{-beta e} increasing on [0, 2/beta], decreasing after, maximum 4 e^{-2}/beta^2; on [l, mu] the infimum is min(phi(l), phi(mu)) and the supremum phi(l) for l >= 1/beta or phi(mu) for mu <= 1/beta (phiT_le_left, phiT_le_right; psi likewise; phi(clamp(1/beta, l, mu)) in the remaining case is phiT_le_max). (i) tail_weight. (ii) c06_tail_phi, c06_tail_psi: the omitted moments lie in (n - k)[lo, hi] for any bounds valid on [l, mu]. (iii) c06_sums: the three sums for Z e^{beta E0}, sum e_i e^{-beta e_i} and sum e_i^2 e^{-beta e_i} lie between the sums of the claimed intervals' bounds and the tail bounds; c06_sums_noM: the same without M (mu = inf) with lower tail ends 0; the quotients, the variance and C then follow by quotient_bounds, variance_bounds and heat_capacity_bounds. Real-number statements; no rounding.

statements.name: C-04 correlation lift
statements.missing: Lemma 1 (compression rounding, a binary64 statement; not attempted, the standard model of CertifyMathlib.Enclosure.FloatModel would serve for it)
statements.correspondence: Lemma 0: tr(P_s V^H O V) = tr(V P_s V^H O) (c04_lemma0). Proposition 1: |tr(Pi_V O) - tr(Pi_Q O)| <= 2 g ||O|| delta (1 + sqrt(1 + iota)) with V = Q M the polar decomposition (Q = polarMat V), Pi_V = V P_s V^H, Pi_Q = Q P_s Q^H and P_s = Q1 Q1^H an orthogonal projector of rank g (c04_prop1). Conclusion without rounding: from |v - tr(P_s V^H O V)| <= b_6, |v - tr(Pi_V O)| <= b_6 and |v - tr(Pi_Q O)| <= b_6 + 2 g ||O|| delta (1 + sqrt(1 + iota)) (c04_conclusion); the term g r_c of Lemma 1 is the rounding of the compression and is not formalized.

statements.name: C-07 moments and sum rules
statements.missing: Lemmas 3 and 4 (floating-point accounting of the repeated products, binary64 statements; not attempted, the standard model of CertifyMathlib.Enclosure.FloatModel would serve for them)
statements.correspondence:
Lemma 1: |tr(P M) - tr(X X^H M)| <= ((#T + g) s + g eta) ||M|| for any M (the document's (2 g s + g eta) ||M|| when #T = g), from the rank bound on traces (norm_trace_herm_le). Lemma 2: tr(X X^H O H^k O) = sum_i for Hermitian O, ||O H^k O|| <= ||O||^2 ||H||^k, and the moment bound (c07_lemma2). Proposition 1 (M2) is Theorem 6 applied to O^2 (thm6_trace) and needs nothing new. Proposition 2 (M3, f-sum form): for an orthogonal projector P commuting with H, tr(P O H O) - tr(P H P O^2) = tr(P [O, [H, O]])/2 (c07_prop2_identity), and a Re tr(P O^2) <= Re tr(P H P O^2) <= b Re tr(P O^2) when a ||P x||^2 <= Re

<= b ||P x||^2, with Re tr(P O^2) = sum_i ||P O e_i||^2 >= 0 (c07_prop2_bounds).

trust_note: Every theorem listed is level K: kernel-checked by the build, no sorry, admit or native_decide, axioms printed. Every module, and the root module, was replayed and accepted by leanchecker (four runs, see second_checker), so every theorem is at least K+. Level K2 means that the theorem, exported with all its dependencies by leanexport, was accepted by the independent kernel nanoda; nanoda was run on the main theorems of each statement (field main) and a statement is K2 when all its main theorems were accepted. A theorem that is only used inside an accepted export is still listed as K+.
floating_point_note: D01Float and P15Float use the standard model of CertifyMathlib.Enclosure.FloatModel with eta = 0 (no underflow) and arbitrary summation trees; constants 1 + 4u and 1 + 8u exact, every product rounded; gamma(k) as gamHat of FloatAccounting; add_up as any succ with z <= succ(fl(z)).
second_checker_note: every module and the root module were replayed by leanchecker in one of four runs and accepted (level K+ for every theorem); nanoda accepted all 71 main theorems (level K2 for the 25 statements that are proved or partial)
